source_game: Zeliard, Sierra On-Line DOS English release (1990); data read from the bit-perfect reconstructed release binaries
key: Towns are keyed by MDT file (e.g. 237MRMP = MRMP.MDT, resource index 33 in the STICK.BIN MDT table) and by place_map_id (stdply byte 0xC4: 0x80 Castle ... 0x89 Esco). town_index is the MDT header byte at C006 (1=Muralla ... 9=Esco; the Castle also stores 1): every building program (shop, bank, inn, sage) indexes its per-town tables with town_index-1. npcs[] follow the MDT NPC array order exactly: npc_index = 0-based position of the 8-byte record in the array pointed to by the MDT word at C00F (the Castle has one extra ending-only record at index -1). NPC record = x (word, tile column in town map), facing byte (+2, bit7 = facing), head tile (+3), animation phase (+4), ai_type (+5, index into npc_ai_jump_table), flags (+6: bit7 = walks up to / stops the hero and talks automatically, bit6 = blocks the path, 0xC0 together = no Spacebar talk), text_id (+7). text_id is a direct 0-based index into the MDT's text pointer array (MDT word at C00D); the same number is used in unreferenced_or_script_texts. lines[] = the text shown under each condition. Conditions are the MDT 'C015' table (conditions_in_order): at town entry and after building visits, for each entry in order, if (stdply[addr] & mask) != 0 the listed bytes are poked into the loaded MDT, so a later matching entry overrides an earlier one. Door x positions match the MDT door array (C009) order: door_index. Door type 0..7 selects the building program, 8+ = cavern entrance (index type-8 into the 5-byte entrance table at C00B), 0xFF = the Pureza trap building.

text_encoding.charset: ASCII glyphs 0x20..0x7E via the game font; strings end with 0xFF
text_encoding.0x26 '&': non-breaking space (renders as a space; the word-wrapper does not break there)
text_encoding.word_wrap: automatic at spaces when the line would exceed 0xA8 (168) pixels; box holds 7 visible lines, then a blinking cursor waits for Spacebar and the box scrolls

opcodes.0x81: Yes/No box; the text continues with text 12 or 13 (0x0C when show_yes_no_dialog returns NC, 0x0D when CF) - only used by the Bosque sentry
opcodes.0x83: give Elf Crest: stdply[0x9A]=0xFF, stdply[0x34]|=0x80, re-apply conditions, wait for key
opcodes.0x85: set dialog-exit flag and continue with text 4
opcodes.0x87: wait for key, then continue with text 5
opcodes.0x89: Asbestos Cape purchase (Yes/No): No -> text 6; almas < 2500 -> text 7; else almas -= 2500, cape added to first free accessory slot (id 5), stdply[0x34]|=0x40, text 8
opcodes.0x8B: stdply[0x04] |= 0x80 and re-apply conditions (not used by any town text)

text_encoding.rendering_in_this_file: text fields are plain English with apostrophes restored, '&' -> space, '/' -> newline, opcodes shown as {NAME}; unknown bytes as {XX}. Spelling, spacing and punctuation are otherwise verbatim (e.g. 'Herada', 'Shirukaano', 'Esko', 'Algaien', 'armor.Duke' are in the data).

building_programs.1: 211OMOYP OMOYPRO.BIN - Princess Felicia's chamber (also triggers the end demo)

weapons_and_armour.stock: per-town bitmask bytes in the save record (swords stdply 0xD2+town_index-1, shields 0xDB+..; bit 0x80 = first item ... 0x04 = sixth). Prices are fixed per town (price table covers every item even when not stocked).
weapons_and_armour.buy: price deducted from carried gold (24-bit). If you already hold a sword/shield, the shopkeeper gives a trade-in of HALF of THIS town's price for the old item (shr/rcr of the 24-bit price) and the old item's bit is set in this town's stock byte so it can be bought back. Buying a shield sets shield HP and max HP to the new shield's value (30/80/180/300/300/600).
weapons_and_armour.repair: cost = ceil((shield_max_HP - shield_HP) / 2) gold (212ARMRP: sub; shr ax,1; adc ax,0). No shield -> refusal text; undamaged -> "not in need of repair". NOT free (community sources say free).
weapons_and_armour.knights_sword_in_tumba: Tumba (town 5) lists the Knight's sword at 4900 but refuses to sell it ("Uh....../I do not sell that weapon...") until the Crest of Glory exchange flag stdply[0x24]&2 is set. Entering the Tumba shop while carrying the Crest of Glory (stdply[0x9B]) and before the exchange runs the crest script: Yes -> sword := Knight's sword (old sword discarded, no trade-in), crest cleared, Tumba stock bit 0x10 removed, stdply[0x24]|=2.

Well, I'd say this sword is all right for a beginner.
You get what you pay for.

Why not take it with you?

You like this one?
A wise choice.
This is a high grade product. It's one of my biggest sellers.
explain_texts.knights_sword:
Oh, I'd be more than happy to tell you about this one.
This is a real man's sword. It'll topple monsters in the wink of an eye.
explain_texts.illumination_sword: You've got a lot of grit I'd say. This one really packs a punch. A top-of-the-line sword for a top-of-the-line-swordsman. Will you take it?

explain_texts.clay_shield: This shield is small and has limited defense capability. It's not very durable -- unless it's used with great skill, it won't last long. It's better than nothing, I guess.
explain_texts.wise_mans_shield: Well, it's slightly better than the Clay Shield. Long ago, a well-known hero used it for a short time. You could do a lot worse.
explain_texts.stone_shield: This one is more of a general-use shield. It's not the best one I carry. I can't really recommend it, I think it will soon be obsolete.
explain_texts.honor_shield: This shield is in a class by itself. It is strong and light and easy to use. This is a superior shield, the least a brave man should have.
explain_texts.light_shield: Ho! You've got quite an eye for these things, I see. This shield is not made of common iron. It is made of a magic metal called Magane. Against ordinary weapons, it's unbreakable.
explain_texts.titanium_shield: This shield makes the mightiest swords seem like paper. It's light as a feather and hard as a diamond. Used well, this one will last you a lifetime.

It's low in price and as a mild health tonic, it's perfect.
descriptions.juuen_fruit:
This is the fruit of the Juu-en tree which bears only once every ten years.
The price is a bit high, but it provides excellent relief from wounds and exhaustion -- it's quite a bit better than the Ken'ko potion.
descriptions.elixir_of_kashi:

It restores magical powers. It's very bitter, but the price is low.
descriptions.chikara_powder:
This is made from a mixture of the powdered dragon scales and crushed Wise Man's Stone steamed for one hundred days.
It will fully restore your magical powers. The price, however..... is high.
descriptions.magia_stone:
This stone protects the aura that living beings exude.
It surrounds the aura to prevent interference from other auras and acts as a protection against enemy attacks.
descriptions.holy_water_of_acero:
This is a liquified metal made from mercury and iron.
If you paint it on a shield weakened by battle, the shield will regain its original strength.
descriptions.sabre_oil:
Hmm... I don't know much about this one, but I do know that it increases the offensive power of a sword.
Don't worry, it hasn't killed anyone yet.
descriptions.kioku_feather:
This feather remembers the voice of the last wise man who spoke to you.
If you hold it in your right hand and swing it once, you'll return to him. It's never failed anyone I know.

bank.title: The Bank
bank.exchange: converts ALL carried almas in one go: while almas >= almas_in: almas -= almas_in; gold += gold_out. Remainder (< almas_in) stays. No almas -> refusal text.
bank.deposit_withdraw: amount chosen with arrows (Left/Right +-1, Up/Down +-10 per manual); gold carried and bank balance are 24-bit values (stdply 0x85-0x87 carried, 0x88-0x8A bank). A deposit of 1000 gold or more (or any 24-bit amount with the high byte set) plays the pleased banner / "Thank you. Come again to make a deposit for a large sum in savings."; smaller deposits get "Next time please deposit a large sum in savings."; leaving without business gets "Unless you have business, don't come in here. I'm a busy man."
bank.death: bank gold is untouched by death (200FIGHT process_hero_death zeroes carried gold and halves almas only)

You are very brave to embark on such a dangerous journey. I shall assist you in your travels.

lines.text: A moment, Duke Garland. If you listen closely in front of the underground door, you will hear a terrifying sound. That's the entrance to the inferno that is home to the demons. Beware that place, young man.

lines.text: Ah, you are the warrior I've heard about. My son Michael was a courageous warrior. He went into the caverns and was never seen again. Please be careful.

Sir, I dreamed that a demon created the underground caverns and filled them with monsters. Then the Spirits brought you to here to make things right again. Before you go, visit the magic shop -- you'll find many useful things there. Good luck on your quest.

You're on your way to the caverns, aren't you? I recently went in search of a powerful potion said to be hidden there. I didn't stay long enough to find it, but perhaps you will. Be sure to stop at the weapons shop -- you'll need some strong armor.Duke Garland, they say that a potion is hidden in a wall near a platform that raises and lowers. I wish you luck.
You're going into the caverns? You are a brave man. They say there are many doors underground, but many are locked and the keys are scattered throughout the labyrinths. I hope you can find them.
Duke Garland, someone I know survived a journey to the underground town, Satono. According to him, the road back is short but the road out is long. It will be very dangerous.
According to the legends, the name of the underground town is Satono.

Alas, I fear there is no hope. You and I and all who inhabit this town will surely perish. Don't run off to some terrible place, stay and have a drink with me. Ah, I know you must go, and I salute you -- you're a braver man than I. God be with you.
When you kill a monster you get a thing called 'almas'. It's worth a lot of money. I'd like to get some myself but I don't want to go down there.

You have come far, and you must be cold. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Fire: Fuego.
sage.knowledge_hint: This is a message from the Spirits: Bend when you walk a low road. Walk not on the steep path with the needles of ice, choose another path instead. Heed well these words.

lines.text: Welcome. You must be cold. Helada used to be a warm, prosperous place, but Jashiin has turned it into a cold ruin.
I think you should know something: Percel the shoemaker said that without the Ruzeria shoes you could not go beyond the green door.

Are you the brave one? My lover, Percel, was killed by Jashiin's underlings just after the Spirits asked him to make the Ruzeria shoes for a brave man. Return my Percel to me! Oh, if only you had not come!

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x1A] & 0x10 - Ruzeria Shoes picked up (Glacial cavern)
lines.text: I'm sorry for what I said a short while ago. I don't know what came over me. Please defeat Jashiin and avenge the death of Percel.

npcs.note: Percel's lover. flags=0x80: she stops the hero and talks when he walks up (the 'interrupting woman'); the Ruzeria Shoes flag clears flags to 0 and changes her text to 7.

lines.text: Have you been in the ice caverns? The shoemaker in this town was trying to make special shoes out of Ruzeria bark, to help a hero walk on the ice. Just as he managed to do so, Jashiin's minions murdered him. I wonder what happened to those shoes.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x1A] & 0x10 - Ruzeria Shoes picked up (Glacial cavern)
lines.text: Ah, the shoes of Percel.... I see you are a brave man. I hope you will find Jashiin and defeat him quickly.
Ruzeria is the name of a tree that grows in the underground forest. The bark is very hard and is not slippery. Percel had good reason for choosing it.
Someone I know said he had seen a pair of unusual shoes in the caverns. I'm not sure whether those are the shoes that Percel made.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x1A] & 0x10 - Ruzeria Shoes picked up (Glacial cavern)
lines.text: This brave man with the Ruzeria shoes... With this the shoemaker's shop also floats up...
I'll bet the green slime creatures have caused you a lot of trouble. Let me tell you a secret: they can't withstand heat. Burn them and they will vanish in a single burst of steam.
You may have noticed that there are two roads leading here. There is also a shortcut.

conditions_in_order.meaning: stdply[0x1A] & 0x10 - Ruzeria Shoes picked up (Glacial cavern)

towns.name: Tumba Town

sage.name: Hisham
sage.intro_text:
I am the Sage Hisham.
You are doing well to stand before me. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Flame: Lanzar.
sage.knowledge_hint: You can't defeat the demons at the edge of the badlands without the Knight's Sword. Until you get that sword, do not open the door of the demons.

lines.text: Brave sir, I hope you've come to help this pitiful town. It was the site of a quiet graveyard before it was decimated by Jashiin.
Have you seen the strange, bluish-white people in the caverns? They were infected by the Gelroid and now they wander the land like the living dead. To kill them, aim for the head.
If you're going back into the caverns, beware the Gelroid. It's a blue gelatinous substance which will suck the life out of you.
One third of this region is covered with deadly Gelroid. If you're going to continue through the labyrinths, ordinary shoes will not protect you.

Have you heard of Percel the shoemaker from Herada Town? He made Ruzeria shoes for walking on ice and Pirika shoes for getting by Gelroid, thorns and fire. Those are the only two I know of, but there may have been more.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x22] & 0x02 - Pirika Shoes chest opened (Corroer cavern)
lines.text: Those are the Pirika shoes. Go quickly to the abode of Jashiin and finish him off. We will pray for your success and swift return.
May I confide in you? I was once a spy for Jashiin. I can tell you that the Pirika shoes were put into a box and thrown away somewhere in the Rotten land. You may never find them.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x22] & 0x02 - Pirika Shoes chest opened (Corroer cavern)
lines.text: Ah, the Pirika shoes! Forgive me, brave sir. I had no choice. I won't do that kind of thing again.

npcs.note: The former spy of Jashiin (text 3). Apologises (text 9) once the Pirika Shoes are found.

lines.text: There is a certain place in the caverns where you can pass through a wall, but only in one direction. My grandfather told me the place is near a green stone slab. There may be other places, but I couldn't say where.
It seems that Jashiin has stolen many things. The weapon maker is searching for his family crest, the Crest of Glory. If you find it in the caverns, he'll be most happy to have it back.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x24] & 0x80 - Crest of Glory picked up (Cementar cavern)
lines.text: Isn't that the Crest of Glory? Please take it quickly to the owner of the weapons store.

towns.name: Dorado Town

sage.name: Maryam
sage.intro_text:
I am the Sage Maryam.
You have made the Spirits proud with your bravery. I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Falling Rocks: Rascar.
sage.knowledge_hint: Once you leave this world, get the Silkarn shoes made by the spirits at the behest of Percel. If you do not get those, you cannot travel far from this world.

lines.text:
Welcome to Dorado.
This was once a thriving merchant town where everyone lived a peaceful life. Jashiin has reduced it to a sad, desolate place.
The Spirits say that Jashiin returned because the people, made soft by peace and prosperity, sank into corruption.
Using the money and treasures of Dorado and other places, Jashiin built a place of his own. The Tesoro and Burata Caverns are his domain.
A word to the wise: The door bearing the green symbol cannot be opened. There's no use trying to force it, it absolutely cannot be opened.
Somewhere in the caverns are the Shirukaano shoes made by the shoemaker Percel. Try to find them; when you wear those shoes you can climb any slope.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x2A] & 0x04 - Silkarn Shoes picked up (Tesoro cavern)
lines.text: Ah! You found the Shirukaano shoes! Now you can scale any slope.
Someone who went into the caverns told me the Shirukaano shoes are hidden in Tesoro. Of the four rooms in the center, they are in the far right room.

lines.condition_meaning: stdply[0x2A] & 0x04 - Silkarn Shoes picked up (Tesoro cavern)
lines.text: Brave lad! A message from the Spirits: Take great care when you enter the next world.
Of the four doors in Tesoro, three bear a blue symbol. What was the other one? For the life of me I can't remember.
This building wasn't here before, was it? You can't put up a building like this overnight -- how did it get here?
A peace statue called 'Taruso' stood here, but one night it disappeared. Where in the world can it have gone? The evil Jashiin must have taken a liking to it.
I have a message from the Spirits: wait for the moving edge of the platform made of shining blocks.
When you find green stone slabs that can be moved up and down, arrange them like a staircase so you can go up easily.
The middle of the caverns is made of pure gold! But there is one fake gold wall that can be destroyed.

conditions_in_order.meaning: stdply[0x2A] & 0x04 - Silkarn Shoes picked up (Tesoro cavern)

sage.knowledge_hint: That world is controlled by dragons. To get there, you have to open three closed doors.

Brave lad, you've done well to get this far.
I shall teach you the Magic Spell of Lightning: Guerra.
sage.knowledge_hint:
At the edge of this world is the final foe, Jashiin.
To fight Jashiin, you must have the Sword of the Fairy Flame. And to get there, you must topple the invincible monster Alguien.

lines.text: Are you from the outside world? Welcome. You are certainly a courageous man guided by the Spirits.
I think you should know that this town is very close to the fortress of Jashiin, and his henchmen are sure to be around. Be careful.
A moment, sir. I have seen the fortress of Jashiin. It is at the edge of this world. The Spirits guided me back from there alive so I could tell you about it.

YOU! The princess you struggle to rescue will lead you to your doom! The Spirits are just demons in disguise. What does this mean? You do the devil's work, you must be the devil!  WA, HA, HA, HA, HA...
The Spirits gave me a lion's head key but it was stolen by one of Jashiin's underlings. I hope you will find it on your travels.

Nearby is a village called Esko, but I don't know what has happened to it recently. I once knew many people there.
I've heard that the lion's head key fell between two towers under a stone slab. It is supposedly near this town.
